title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Measures on Establishing and Managing the List Database of Judicial Online Quotation Platforms
full_text_en:
NOTICE OF THE SUPREME PEOPLE'S COURT ON ISSUING THE MEASURES FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT AND ADMINISTRATION OF THE LIST DATABASE OF JUDICIAL ONLINE APPRAISAL PLATFORMS

Fa Fa [2020] No. 18

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Measures for the Establishment and Administration of the List Database of Judicial Online Appraisal Platforms of the Supreme People's Court are hereby issued for your compliance.

May 26, 2020

Measures for the Establishment and Administration of the List Database of Judicial Online Appraisal Platforms

These Measures are formulated to implement the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Determination of Reference Prices for Property Disposition (hereinafter referred to as the Provisions on Determination of Reference Prices), to scientifically establish and administer a nationwide list database of judicial online appraisal platforms, and to ensure that the work of judicial online appraisal by the people's courts proceeds lawfully and orderly.

Article 1 The Supreme People's Court shall establish a nationwide list database of judicial online appraisal platforms, and may set up sub-databases based on the types of appraised property.

Article 2 The Supreme People's Court shall establish an Evaluation Committee for the List Database of Judicial Online Appraisal Platforms (hereinafter referred to as the Evaluation Committee), which shall be responsible for the evaluation, selection, and removal of online appraisal platforms. The Evaluation Committee shall be composed of deputies to the National People's Congress, members of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, special supervisors and specially invited advisors of the Supreme People's Court, experts in Internet big data, experts in the appraisal industry, and personnel from relevant departments of the Supreme People's Court.

Article 3 Any Internet service provider that can offer an online appraisal platform meeting the requirements of the Provisions on Determination of Reference Prices and these Measures, and that intends to conduct judicial online appraisal business, may submit an application for inclusion in the database to the Evaluation Committee.

An applicant for inclusion shall submit an application letter for inclusion and relevant supporting documents that meet the requirements.

Article 4 An online appraisal platform provided by an Internet service provider applying for inclusion shall satisfy all of the following conditions:

(1) It possesses the qualifications to lawfully conduct and provide Internet information services;

(2) It possesses, lawfully obtained, data on no fewer than three types of prices for the same type of property in various regions nationwide over a certain period, such as historical transaction prices, government-set prices, government-guided prices, or market public transaction prices, and at least one type of such data is owned by the Internet service provider itself;

(3) Each type of price data shall be continuously updated, with an update cycle not exceeding three months;

(4) It has the capability to use certain calculation rules to analyze historical market transaction prices and transaction trends, and to issue a reference price for disposition;

(5) It has operational norms to ensure the safe, convenient, and orderly conduct of judicial online appraisal work, a safe and efficient information system, as well as hardware equipment, funds, and personnel, and provides services of high quality and low cost;

(6) The information system shall be open, advanced, and sustainable, capable of achieving information exchange and sharing with the people's courts' systems, and of promptly providing expanded services in response to work demands;

(7) It has provided online appraisal services for judicial organs, administrative organs, or matters involving public affairs for more than one year;

(8) It is in a leading position among similar platforms in terms of technical support, data management, security guarantees, and social impact;

(9) It has no record of illegal or irregular conduct.

Article 5 An Internet service provider shall be responsible for the security of the online appraisal platform it provides.

Article 6 The Evaluation Committee has the authority to examine all underlying data, data sources, data updates, calculation methods, and other circumstances on which a judicial online appraisal platform relies for conducting online appraisals, to ensure that the platform conducts judicial online appraisal work lawfully, compliantly, scientifically, and efficiently.

Article 7 The Evaluation Committee shall entrust an authoritative third party to evaluate the online appraisal platforms applying for inclusion. Based on the evaluation results, the Evaluation Committee shall select the best platforms for inclusion in the database and make a public announcement. It shall also assess the performance of judicial online appraisals by the platforms already included in the database each year. Based on the assessment results, the Evaluation Committee shall issue requirements for rectification within a specified time limit, determine the platforms to be removed based on poor performance, and make a public announcement.

Article 8 If a major operational change occurs with the Internet service provider providing the judicial online appraisal platform or the judicial online appraisal platform itself that affects the normal operation of judicial online appraisal business, the Internet service provider shall promptly report to the Evaluation Committee.

If an Internet service provider no longer provides judicial online appraisal services, it shall apply to the Evaluation Committee in writing three months in advance for withdrawal from the list database, and shall not unilaterally discontinue the service. If an Internet service provider unilaterally discontinues the service without applying for withdrawal to the Evaluation Committee as required, it shall be removed from the list database, and no further application for inclusion shall be accepted.

Article 9 If a judicial online appraisal platform falls under any circumstance specified in Article 9 of the Provisions on Determination of Reference Prices as a violation, the Evaluation Committee shall, after evaluation, remove it from the list database and make a public announcement.

Article 10 Where a judicial online appraisal platform is removed or is permitted to withdraw from the list database, it shall properly handle follow-up matters, including ensuring that ongoing online appraisals and pending corrections are completed smoothly.

Article 11 These Measures shall enter into force on June 1, 2020.
